ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels appearing as sparse, localized clusters and narrow linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel concentrations are mapped primarily along the trailing edges and terminal tips; the central and leading regions exhibit a dense distribution of non-contiguous white geometric patterns over a dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 45 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within the central bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the continuous boundary of both lobes; pixel-amplitude variations indicate significant micro-serration interspersed with larger wave-like undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the distal margins, with both lobes exhibiting an upward-sloping sweep toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of circular and sub-circular white pixel rings of varying radii (5-15 pixels) distributed across the mid-region of both lobes, representing discrete high-contrast clusters.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional white linear tracks (rake marks) that intersect across the central and outer fluke lobes, creating a complex lattice of pixel disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, bulbous, high-intensity white-pigmented mass is visible at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, distorting the standard geometric terminal curve.
other_distinctive_markers: A exceptionally high density of intersecting rake marks localized on the central dark regions, resulting in a unique high-frequency texture map.
